source_text: Health risks further diverge: FGM, typically performed without anesthesia in non-sterile conditions, carries high rates of immediate complications such as hemorrhage (up to 15% in some cohorts), infection, and death, alongside long-term issues including urinary tract infections, chronic pain, keloid scarring, and obstetric complications like vesicovaginal fistulas during childbirth, which affect over 10% of infibulated women. [35]
